name: Reed Bank
mix: Yellow belt and up. Bouncy Boppers + swarmers: watch for the staff going up, then step aside or Counter.
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from bopper-yard. Theme and props from the quiet-river draft room "reed-bank". Tall soft reeds along both sides (the '#' blocks are reed clumps); lily pads on the floor.
